title: UBS PVP
description: FOR PVP AND SMP It improves device performance through special mods, and we've also added special combat mods. We selected the mods from multiple builds to ensure you get the best.
body:
Welcome to UBS PVP!

UBS PVP is the ultimate, high-performance Fabric modpack meticulously designed to deliver the smoothest possible experience in competitive PvP and multiplayer Survival (SMP). Instead of just adding random content, this pack focuses on maximizing your hardware's capability, optimizing network stability, and giving you critical visual advantages.

**What Does This Modpack Do? (The Core Benefits)**

* Extreme Performance & FPS Boost: By combining industry-leading engines like Sodium, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, and CCME, the pack optimizes how chunks, lights, and entities are rendered. This ensures massive FPS gains and eliminates micro-stutters, even during chaotic team fights.
* Network & Ping Optimization: Mods like Krypton and Better Ping Display optimize network packets and connection stability, ensuring your hits register instantly without ghost-blocks or desync.
* PvP & Combat Advantage: Features like Small Shield & Totem, BetterHurtCam, and PVP Optimizer clean up your screen clutter. You get better crosshairs, reduced fire overlay, smaller shields, and clear indicators (Heart Indicator, Armor Durability HUD) so you can focus entirely on tracking your opponent.
* Survival & Quality of Life (QoL): For survival players, Xaero’s Maps provide world tracking, AppleSkin shows saturation, and Shulker Box Tooltip lets you peek inside shulkers instantly without placing them.

**Who Is This Modpack For?**
This pack is tailor-made for competitive PvP players, base builders, and multiplayer SMP enthusiasts who own high-end or mid-range PCs and want zero performance compromise.

**⚠️ Critical Warnings & Technical Notice!**

* Multiplayer Only (No Singleplayer Worlds): Due to technical optimizations and specific server-side bridging dependencies, you cannot create or play in a Singleplayer Local World with this modpack. Attempting to generate a new world will cause the game to crash. This pack is strictly built and optimized for joining Multiplayer Servers.
* Server Rules Warning (Minimap): This modpack includes Xaero's Minimap/World Map. Many competitive or hardcore survival servers consider Freecam and entity-tracking maps as a form of cheating or illegal modification. Please disable or remove these two mods if you are playing on a server that bans them to avoid getting banned!

**Highlighting the Key Mods & Features:**

* Sodium & Sodium Extra: The definitive rendering engine replacement that dramatically increases FPS.
* Iris Shaders: Allows you to run shaders smoothly without ruining your performance.
* Xaero's Minimap & World Map: Full-featured map system to navigate and set waypoints.
* Essential Mod & e4mc: Easily invite friends to your world or customize your cosmetic look.
* Dynamic FPS & FPS Reducer: Lowers PC resource usage when the game is minimized or idle.
* Simple Voice Chat: Proximity voice chat for seamless in-game communication with friends.
* Gamma Utils (Fullbright): Toggleable full brightness so you never have to worry about lighting up dark caves.
